rows.title: A CT child tax credit in 2026? Advocates vow to resume battle
rows.standfirst: Advocates say new reports will help make their case for a CT child tax credit by emphasizing hefty tax burdens and a high cost of living.

rows.title: CT employee union takes Lamont to arbitration after no raise offer
rows.standfirst: After the unit announced its plans, SEBAC said it ‘would not expect a single one of our units to accept’ Lamont’s wage freeze proposal.

rows.title: Two more CT unions break off contract talks with Lamont
rows.standfirst: The Judicial Branch unions declared an impasse after being offered $2,000 bonuses, just days after Lamont’s office said it would offer raises.

rows.title: Lawmakers carve a new path around CT budget cap
rows.standfirst: Conservatives say the move is a push toward irresponsible spending. But progressives counter it’s the only way to protect core services.

rows.title: Lamont predicts salary deals with all CT employee unions
rows.standfirst: CT state employee unions expect raises similar to what state troopers received in May, but it’s unclear if matching raises are on the table.

rows.title: CT tax receipts keep pouring in — after lawmakers wrap their work
rows.standfirst: Legislators who watered down several initiatives in the new CT budget on the assumption finances weren’t as rosy remain frustrated.
